svg.title: One layout, three analyses
svg.desc: One DAG of alcohol use and coronary events, drawn three times on the same layout. Unadjusted: three backdoor paths are open. Adjusted for household income, baseline health and smoking: every backdoor path is blocked. Baseline health unobserved: its backdoor path stays open. No variable moves between the views.
svg.text: No adjustment: three backdoor paths from alcohol use to coronary events stay open.
Adjusting for income, baseline health and smoking blocks every backdoor path.
Baseline health is unobserved, so its backdoor path cannot be blocked.
